Fixture design

Present — must produce 0 findings.

Absent — must produce exactly 1 finding, "no such file".

A directory, not a file — must produce exactly 1 finding, distinguishable from "no such file" per FR-006.

An absolute path — must be rejected as escaping the project root, never followed.

A .. traversal — must be rejected as escaping the project root, never followed.

Resolves inside specs/ — must be rejected as an effective declaration regardless of whether the file exists.

Looks like it starts with "specs" as a substring, but is a sibling directory — must resolve as absent (no such file), never as a specs/-containment rejection.
